body: Background API missing badge setter (High): setPerpsTabBadgeSeen calls submitRequestToBackground('setPerpsTabBadgeSeen', ...) but that method is not registered on the background MetamaskController API alongside other AppState setters. Dismissal likely fails at runtime.
action: Already fixed on branch: setPerpsTabBadgeSeen IS registered (metamask-controller.js binding, app-state-controller.ts:757 + handler :1335, action type :285, legacy-background-api-service wired). Thread resolved. No new change this run.

body: Duplicate Perp Screen Viewed events (Medium): Mapping the Perps overview tab to PerpsScreenViewed makes handleTabClick emit that event on every tab click while PerpsView already fires it, doubling analytics counts.
action: Already fixed: Perps is NOT in ACCOUNT_OVERVIEW_TAB_KEY_TO_METAMETRICS_EVENT_NAME_MAP (only Tokens/DeFi/Activity). No duplicate event. Thread resolved + outdated. No new change this run.

body: Dismisses badge without Perps tab (Medium): The mount effect persists perpsTabBadgeSeen when activeTabKey is perps and showPerpsTabBadge is true, but does not require the Perps experience to be available, permanently hiding the badge if Perps later becomes available.
action: Already fixed: mount effect (account-overview-tabs.tsx:154-158) is gated on showPerpsTabBadge, which requires isPerpsExperienceAvailable (:119-122). Badge can't be marked seen when Perps unavailable. Thread resolved + outdated. No new change this run.

body: Do we need a migration here?
action: No migration needed: perpsTabBadgeSeen is a new AppStateController field with a default (false) handled by state init. Author replied (3451236916), thread resolved.
